page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. With a one-to-one thread-to-core ratio, each vCPU maps directly to a physical core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading overhead.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating efficient data transfer for memory-intensive applications.

From a qualitative perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density offer a balanced cost-to-resource profile for workloads requiring large memory footprints without the need for local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. This hardware configuration is suited for enterprise databases, in-memory caching systems, large-scale data processing, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
